title: RCF Project Manifest
description: Project manifest. Roots-only shape: declares prd, tad, bs. Children are owned by their parents and discovered by walking from the roots. From 0.4.0 the manifest also carries optional records for pre-flight configuration, review audits, UI baselines, browser verification, baseline-AC opt-outs, intake classification, register-regression canaries, and the review-surface state. From 0.4.1 the manifest additionally carries optional shipWithoutVerified acknowledgements written by rcf finalise --ship-without-verified. From 0.4.2 the testTheatreFinding shape carries an optional anchorId and drops tsId from its required list when kind is uiBaselineDrift (the drift finding is not anchored on a test suite); every other kind still requires tsId, and any 0.4.0- or 0.4.1-valid record remains valid. From 0.4.4 the manifest carries two optional additive sections that host the blueprint-library mechanism: blueprints[] (applied-blueprints registry written by rcf blueprint add / remove / upgrade) and standards[] (standards-pack registry written at rcf init and rcf standards add). Every added field is optional; pre-0.4.0 manifests remain valid.

testCommand.description: The project's declared test command (for example, pnpm -r test). Read by the review-audit mutation sampler and by any other tool that needs to invoke the project's tests.

preFlightConfig.description: Pre-flight configuration records. One per rcf preflight invocation. Each entry captures the operator's attestation-mode ruling for every third-party service the scanner surfaced against the PRD or TAD, plus any design-shape answers the operator recorded in the same session.

reviewAudit.description: Review-stage audit records. One entry per Review pass, keyed by fbsId. Carries both test-theatre findings and mutation-sampling results.

uiBaselineHistory.description: Previous UI-baseline records, appended when rcf ui-baseline init --reset writes a fresh baseline. Observability record so an operator can answer why the theme default changed.

browserVerification.description: Browser-verification gate records. One entry per UI-bearing FBS's Finalise pass.

baselineAcOptOuts.description: Persistent ledger of operator rulings that remove a baseline acceptance criterion. Later user stories under the same requirement inherit the rulings without re-prompting.

registerCanary.description: Register-regression canary records. One entry per canary run at release preparation.

shipWithoutVerified.description: Operator acknowledgements recorded when rcf finalise --ship-without-verified acknowledges a MOCK-ONLY-DECLARED or BLOCKED-BY-DECLARATION verdict on the verify report and ships the FBS at complete without promoting to verified. One entry per acknowledgement (verification-integrity-cluster-spec section 5.2). The ack is durable and greppable at ship time.

blueprints.description: Applied-blueprints registry. One entry per rcf blueprint add / upgrade invocation on the project. Records the blueprint's slug, applied version, source, namespace and the ids and paths the blueprint contributed to the tree. Written by the rcf blueprint verb family; read by rcf blueprint list / remove / upgrade. Optional; projects that never call rcf blueprint have no entries. Composition (multiple applied blueprints) is expressed by multiple entries with distinct slugs.

standards.description: Standards-pack registry. One entry per standards folder registered at rcf init (or later via rcf standards add). Records the pack's id, slug, source path, optional copy path (present only when the source lived outside the project root and was copied into rcf/standards/<slug>/ for portability), tag vocabulary, testsProvidedBy classification, and provenance. Read by the bundle assembler's selective-retrieval step when populating fbs.contextRequirements.standardIds. Optional; projects that register no standards have no entries.

id.description: Pre-flight config record id. Format: pfc-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN. Monotonic per project.

servicesInScope.description: One entry per third-party service candidate the operator ruled on. Empty array is legitimate for projects that named no services.

designShapeAnswers.description: Design-shape questions the operator answered in the same session. Optional; existing records without the field remain valid.

sourceRefs.description: Where in the PRD or TAD the service was named (for example, PRD-001#external-integrations). Provenance so an operator can review the derivation. Operator-added candidates may carry an empty array when the operator introduced the service at pre-flight without a PRD or TAD reference.

credentialSupplied.description: Whether the operator supplied a key or token at pre-flight.

sandboxProvisioned.description: Whether a sandbox account was stood up for this service.

operatorReason.description: Plain-text reason. Required in practice when attestationMode is declaredMockOnly or notShipped.

affectedFbsIds.description: FBS ids in the build queue that will inherit this service. May be back-filled at plan time.

questionId.description: Catalogue id of the design-shape question (for example, auth.htmlLoginPage).

reqId.description: Requirement the question was posed against, when the question is REQ-scoped.

answer.description: Operator's answer. Value vocabulary is per question (for example, htmlLoginPage or apiOnly for auth.htmlLoginPage).

reason.description: Plain-text reason. Required in practice when the answer triggers a downstream opt-out ledger write; the ledger entry then applies the 20-character floor at its own site.

id.description: Review-audit record id. Format: ra-<fbsId>-<n>; the trailing integer increments per re-audit of the same FBS. Accepts both numeric-only and kebab-slug FBS ids.

testTheatreFindings.description: One entry per issue the audit found. Empty array is legitimate; a clean audit is itself a finding.

verdict.description: Aggregated verdict for the audit. block if any finding severity is block; warn if any warn and no block; pass otherwise.

operatorAckAt.description: Set when the operator has read a warn or block verdict.

anchorId.description: Free-form anchor for findings whose kind does not map to a test suite (for example, uiBaselineDrift, which anchors on the FBS id or a file path). Optional; test-theatre kinds keep tsId as the anchor.

kind.description: Category of the finding. uiBaselineDrift is added by the UI-design-gate track for FBS implementations that contradict a uiBaseline default. otherDeclared requires a kindDescription.

kindDescription.description: Free-text description; required in practice when kind is otherDeclared.

severity.description: Severity of the finding. Only block severities force a block verdict on the audit.

mode.description: Which mutation-sampling implementation ran (for example, agent-v1, native-stryker).

notes.description: Free text; for example, no code changes when the FBS diff is config-only.

mutationSummary.description: One-line semantic description of the mutation (for example, flip guard condition).

id.description: UI-baseline record id. Format: uib-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN. Monotonic per project.

operatorOptOuts.description: Explicit operator overrides to individual defaults. Silence is never an opt-out; every override lands here with a reason.

themeMode.description: Project-wide theme posture. Estate default is light-default-with-toggle.

viewFileGlobs.description: Globs the hex-literal audit scopes to. Defaults to src/ui/** minus the design tokens module when omitted.

uiBaselineDefaults.description: Ruled UI defaults for the project. Every field is optional at schema so partial baselines validate; the interactive init verb visits every field before writing operatorAckAt.

declaredComponents.description: The vocabulary of components a UI-bearing FBS may use (for example, Button, Input, Card, Badge, Table, Notice).

htmlLoginPageRequired.description: True when the project ships an HTML login page. Written by the preflight design-shape answer for auth.htmlLoginPage and read by the browser-verify smoke pack.

field.description: JSON-path string into defaults naming the field the operator overrode (for example, componentVocabulary.declaredComponents).

id.description: Browser-verification record id. Format: bv-<fbsId>-<n>. Accepts both numeric-only and kebab-slug FBS ids.

mode.description: Which path satisfied the gate. operatorSession: the operator loaded the app and cleared the pages themselves. agentScreenshotCritique: a subagent drove a browser and critiqued screenshots.

runtimeProfile.description: Runtime profile the check drove against. Default is local-dev per the build-cycle playbook.

invariantChecks.description: One entry per invariant from the FBS's designStage.navModel and inherited uiBaseline.defaults.

authSmokeChecks.description: Auth-REQ smoke pack results when the FBS binds an auth requirement. Empty when no auth requirement is bound.

notes.description: Free text carrying the agent's critique rubric findings (component consistency, typography, interaction affordances, modern-versus-dated feel).

verdict.description: Aggregated verdict for the browser-verification run.

operatorShipDespiteBlockReason.description: Operator's reason for shipping despite a block verdict. Written by --accept-block on --mark complete.

screenshotPath.description: Project-relative path to the screenshot artefact, typically under .rcf/artefacts/.

themeApplied.description: Which theme was applied when the screenshot was taken.

invariant.description: Free-string invariant name from the versioned UI_INVARIANTS module (for example, sharedNavPresent, themeToggleVisible). The set is module-encoded in v1; a v2 minor bump can schema-encode once it stabilises.

check.description: Which smoke check ran (for example, GET /login or POST /logout).

id.description: Opt-out record id. Format: boo-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN. Monotonic per project.

reqId.description: Requirement the opt-out applies to. Required in practice when scope is req.

baselineKey.description: Catalogue key the opt-out removes (for example, auth.htmlLoginPage).

scope.description: Whether the opt-out applies to a single requirement or to the whole project.

reason.description: Operator's plain-text ruling. Minimum 20 characters; a one-word answer reads as silence, which is exactly what this ledger exists to prevent.

linkedPreFlightConfigRef.description: Back-reference to a preFlightConfig record when the opt-out was recorded via preflight rather than the direct opt-out verb (for example, pfc-2026-07-30-001#designShapeAnswers.auth.htmlLoginPage).

id.description: Intake classification record id. Format: ic-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN.

fidelity.description: Classifier verdict on what the operator supplied. none: nothing supplied. napkin: one paragraph or a sketch. briefLight: half-page brief. briefStrong: full product brief with NFRs and out-of-scope. prd: full PRD. prdPlusTad: PRD plus a technical architecture doc.

validationFindings.description: Findings raised at phase 2. Empty array is legitimate; a clean artefact still records the empty result.

hash.description: Content hash for later drift detection (for example, sha256:...).

operatorSourced.description: True when the operator supplied the artefact; false when the agent drafted it earlier in the same session.

kindDescription.description: Required in practice when kind is otherDeclared.

prdDrafted.description: supplied: the artefact carried the PRD. drafted: derived from the artefact by intake. gap: needs elicitation.

verdict.description: pass when every graded dimension passed. Any dimension fail forces a top-level fail.

shipDespiteFailReason.description: Operator's reason for shipping a fail verdict via --accept-fail.

matches.description: Substrings the pattern set matched. Empty on pass.

reviewSurfaceRecord.description: Persisted state of the interactive review surface. Currently carries viewServer; further review-surface state composes into the same record additively.

mode.description: Server lifecycle mode. foreground matches the current pre-0.4.0 behaviour; detached is the default for interactive sessions.

id.description: Ship-without-verified acknowledgement id. Format: swv-<fbsId>-<n>; the trailing integer increments per acknowledgement of the same FBS. Accepts both numeric-only and kebab-slug FBS ids.

declaredAcs.description: The per-AC verdicts on the verify report that the operator acknowledged. At least one entry, otherwise there is nothing to acknowledge.

reportPath.description: Path (repo-relative or absolute as recorded by finalise) to the verify report file that carried the acknowledged verdicts.

shipWithoutVerifiedRecord.description: Operator acknowledgement recorded on rcf finalise --ship-without-verified. Records the FBS, the verify verdicts acknowledged, and the report they came from, so the ack is durable and greppable at ship time.

verdict.description: The verify per-AC verdict class the operator acknowledged. Only these two verdict classes are legitimately acknowledgeable via --ship-without-verified.

reason.description: Optional verify-supplied reason string carried through from the report entry.

source.description: Where the blueprint was resolved from at apply time (for example, a registry path, a git ref, or a local file path). Provenance for rcf blueprint upgrade.

namespace.description: Doc-id namespace used for this blueprint's contributions. Defaults to slug when omitted; the field exists so an operator can rename the namespace at add-time to avoid a project-authored slug collision.

contributions.description: Every doc id and file path the blueprint contributed to the tree at apply time. Makes rcf blueprint remove and rcf blueprint upgrade mechanical: remove deletes exactly these paths and refuses when any project-authored doc references any of these ids; upgrade diffs the new contribution set against this one.

appliedBlueprintRecord.description: One applied-blueprint record. Written by rcf blueprint add on clean apply and rewritten by rcf blueprint upgrade; removed by rcf blueprint remove.

id.description: Contributed doc id (for example, spa-REQ-001, or TAC-002-spa-logging when the doc kind namespaces via kebab-suffix). Schema-wise a minLength: 1 string because the union of all doc-id patterns is enforced at the owning doc's schema.

path.description: Project-relative path the contribution was written to (for example, rcf/requirements/spa-req-001.json).

kind.description: Optional doc-kind classifier. Purely informational; the id + path pair is authoritative.

scope.description: ADR contributions only: marks a whole-project decision (auth model, error envelope, versioning strategy). Two applied blueprints each contributing a scope:global ADR on the same topic is a hard conflict, surfaced by rcf blueprint add. Absent for non-global contributions.

topic.description: ADR contributions only, required in practice when scope=global: the topic key the conflict detector matches on (for example, 'versioning', 'auth', 'errorEnvelope'). Absent for non-global contributions.

id.description: Standards-pack record id. Format: std-<slug>. Slug is repeated in the id so the record id is grep-friendly across the manifest.

sourcePath.description: Path to the standards content. When the source lives inside the project root the pack is referenced in place (no copy is written); when outside, the pack is copied into rcf/standards/<slug>/ and copyPath records the copy destination.

copyPath.description: Present only when sourcePath was outside the project root at registration time. Points at the in-tree mirror under rcf/standards/<slug>/. Absent for in-repo sources (reference-by-default).

tags.description: Ordered tag vocabulary for this pack (for example, naming, security, logging, ui, api). Read by the bundle assembler's selective-retrieval step alongside the pack summary when scoring relevance to an FBS's work text.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the pack's scope. Read by the selective-retrieval step; omitted for guidance-only packs where the tags carry enough signal.

testsProvidedBy.description: How adherence to this pack is expressed. standard: the pack ships adherence checks that convert into ACs in the tree at registration or standards add time. agent: the working agent derives adherence from the pack's prose during build. none: guidance-only; the pack contributes prose that lands in the bundle but no adherence tests.

provenance.description: Records whether the pack is a personal pattern collection or a corporate standards library. Reads at bundle-time as informational; init records the distinction so a project-level report can name where each pack came from.

standardsPackRecord.description: One standards-pack registration. Written by rcf init (during standards prompting) and rcf standards add; read by the bundle assembler's selective-retrieval step.
